claims.text: Anthropic, via ``claude -p --output-format json`` with tools disallowed.
claims.why: The actual CLI invocation is not shown in this chunk; _dispatch builds argv from profile, but no profile definition is present.

claims.text: A non-JSON body from --output-format json means the contract moved under us; that is an error, not silently-usable prose.
claims.why: The code catches json.JSONDecodeError (via except (ValueError, TypeError)) and returns status 'error' with reason 'bad_response'.

claims.text: ALWAYS read-only.  There is no constructor switch for the sandbox mode: a reviewer that can write is not a reviewer, and an option is a thing someone sets.
claims.why: The CodexAdapter class body in this chunk is empty; the constructor and sandbox enforcement are not visible.

observations.what: ClaudeAdapter._parse_ok expects JSON output from 'claude -p --output-format json' and parses it; if stdout is not JSON, returns error.
CodexAdapter docstring strongly asserts read-only sandbox, but the class implementation is not present in this chunk.
_looks_unauthenticated uses a tuple of markers to detect auth failures; used by ClaudeAdapter._auth_failure.
_CliAdapter._dispatch uses council_cwd and council_env, which are imported but not defined in this chunk.
